toolCall.argumentsJson:
{"CommandLine":"$before = Get-PSDrive C
Write-Host "=== BEFORE PURGE: Drive C Free GB: $([math]::Round($before.Free/1GB, 2)) ==="

Write-Host "1. Deleting LiveKernel dump..."
if (Test-Path "C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports\NetAdapterCx-20260718-1837.dmp") {
    Remove-Item "C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports\NetAdapterCx-20260718-1837.dmp" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

Write-Host "2. Disabling Windows Hibernation (Desktop 64GB)..."
powercfg.exe /h off

Write-Host "3. Purging NVIDIA DXCache..."
if (Test-Path "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\NVIDIA\DXCache") {
    Remove-Item "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\NVIDIA\DXCache\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

Write-Host "4. Purging pip cache..."
pip cache purge

Write-Host "5. Purging npm cache..."
npm cache clean --force

Write-Host "6. Purging Temp directories..."
Remove-Item "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "7. Purging Chrome DevTools MCP cache..."
if (Test-Path "C:\Users\footb\.cache\chrome-devtools-mcp") {
    Remove-Item "C:\Users\footb\.cache\chrome-devtools-mcp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

Write-Host "8. Emptying Recycle Bin..."
Clear-RecycleBin -DriveLetter C -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "9. Clearing freed Chrome IndexedDB video blobs (already salvaged to Drive E)..."
$streamlabsBlob = "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\IndexedDB\https_videoeditor.streamlabs.com_0.indexeddb.blob"
if (Test-Path $streamlabsBlob) {
    Remove-Item $streamlabsBlob -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
$vislaBlob = "C:\Users\footb\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\IndexedDB\https_app.visla.us_0.indexeddb.blob"
if (Test-Path $vislaBlob) {
    Remove-Item $vislaBlob -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$after = Get-PSDrive C
Write-Host "=== AFTER PURGE: Drive C Free GB: $([math]::Round($after.Free/1GB, 2)) ==="
$gained = [math]::Round(($after.Free - $before.Free)/1GB, 2)
Write-Host "=== TOTAL DRIVE C SPACE RECLAIMED: $gained GB ==="","Cwd":"C:\AI-BS","IsDaemon":false,"WaitMsBeforeAsync":10000,"toolAction":"Executing Drive C cleanup","toolSummary":"Purge zero-risk caches and video blobs"}
